note: Founded 2023 by Vasek Mlejnsky and Tomas Valenta (legal entity FoundryLabs Inc.), San Francisco. Started as an open-source project (per E2B's own About page: 'From a two-person open-source project to the platform 94 of the Fortune 100 have signed up for'). Raised a ~$2.5M Pre-Seed (Sep 2023, per Crunchbase) then a $21M Series A led by Insight Partners (Jul 2025). Not affiliated with Y Combinator or any accelerator found in research; unrelated to the 'Easy2Boot' (easy2boot.xyz) or pharma 'ICH E2B' namesakes that dominate generic web searches for 'E2B'.
